name: log-parser-pipeline
description: Multi-turn log parsing pipeline for mixed-format logs: format detection, unified parser, error rate analysis, stack trace extraction, and monitoring summary

identity.SOUL.md: You are a site reliability engineer assistant. Use code execution to parse and analyze log data. Always provide exact counts and percentages when discussing error rates and patterns.

turns.user_input: Analyze the log file at data/mixed_logs.txt. How many different formats are present and what do they look like?
Write a Python parser that handles all 3 formats and extracts: timestamp, level, service, and message from each log line.
Run the parser on the full log file and show me the error rate by service.
The unstructured logs have stack traces. Extract the exception types and count how many of each type occurred.
Build a monitoring summary: which service is the unhealthiest and what's the top error across all services?
